description: Inpatient polytrauma primary survey. 21 Ziffern across chapters B, C, F, M and O reach the rules engine; 14 are charged and 7 are blocked. Exercises all three suppression layers and three arbitration clusters in one solve, plus § 6a Minderung on every line.

blocked_ziffern.note: Nr. 5, Nr. 7 and Nr. 8 exclude one another mutually (Anmerkungen zu den Nummern 5 bis 8), so all three go to arbitration together and exactly one survives. Nr. 8 wins on evidence (1.0 vs 0.85 vs 0.60).

The other loser of the same three-way cluster. Note that rule_id on these entries names *a* pair the position is in, not necessarily the pair against the winner — the legal basis is the same Anmerkung either way. See docs/audit/GOLDEN_CORPUS.md, finding G-1.

Second three-way cluster: Nr. 422 to Nr. 424 are not chargeable next to one another. The fully documented Doppler study (Nr. 424, confidence 1.0) wins over the Real-Time recording (Nr. 423, 0.85) and the Time-Motion mention (Nr. 422, 0.55).
Third cluster, Nr. 650 to Nr. 653. The twelve-lead resting ECG beats the monitor strip. Nr. 659 is NOT part of this cluster and stays on the invoice.

The knee puncture matches the generic Nr. 300 and the knee-specific Nr. 301; specificity (rule spec_301_300) resolves it in Datalog. The shoulder puncture is a different act and keeps its own Nr. 302 — one act, one position, and two punctures are two acts.

The critical stratification check in this case: the dressing is blocked by Nr. 301, the parent that SURVIVED specificity, and not by Nr. 300, which was itself suppressed one layer earlier. A position that has already lost must not suppress a third one.

factor_expectations.note: 'schwer' on the whole-body status: shock-room conditions, intubated patient, repeated survey. Takes the winner of the arbitration to the Höchstsatz. The factor plays no part in deciding the arbitration — the objective ranks positions by points, never by fee.
The shoulder puncture has no documented difficulty of its own, and the justification naming proc_punktion_knie must not leak onto it — even though both acts map into the same Leistungsgruppe.
Abschnitt O takes the § 5 Abs. 3 band.

note_on_minderung: § 6a Abs. 1 GOÄ: a stationär encounter is reduced by 25 % on every line, and none of these positions is exempt under § 6a Abs. 1 Satz 3. This is the only bundled case in which the reduction actually fires, so it is the one that would fail if the exemption list or the rate moved.
